boundary: Begin at surveyed named retained foundry/melt-shop and approved reconstruction scope; include required isolation/old-equipment and refractory removals, actual foundation/pit/melt-deck/platform alterations, integrated actual furnace/power/coil/control/hydraulic/charge-handling/cooling/fume-capture interfaces, construction/testing resources, approved progressive pre-start/cold checks, initial lining installation/dryout/sintering where actually required, supervised hot trial heats, correction/retest and signed owner/contractor handover. Retained building, services, old equipment and metal heel are baseline stocks, not new purchases. Associated offsite/provider/temporary assets, freight, test/spare/continuity resources counted once. Reconstructing specialized plant across civil/installed process/service interfaces is essential; equipment-only supply or isolated machine erection is excluded.
gate: Actual approved plant reconstruction package with civil/support checks, installed equipment register/package scope, cold electrical/grounding/protection/interlock/emergency-stop/cooling/hydraulic checks, extraction/capture indicators and adopted commissioning-control checks, required initial refractory commissioning, actual supervised ferrous trial heat/tapping/shutdown results under project-specific criteria, closed defects, drawings/O&M/training and signed acceptance. Not merely mechanical completion, and not an automatic safety certificate, emission-limit compliance guarantee or lifetime production capability. Unknown applicable adoption/authority/criteria must be resolved by actual project records; no recipe or safety operating instructions are invented.
context: N>0 unique complete accepted integrated plant reconstruction intervention IDs. Count an actual contracted coordinated plant scope once, not each furnace, foundation, m2, MW, tonne of melt, heat, phase or test. Declare ferrous metal family, actual retained/replaced scope, capacity/configuration, furnace count, actual utilities/extraction/charge route, commissioning period, approved criteria and responsibility limits for comparability. Capacity is a qualifier only.
reuse: Fresh376-record material catalog reviewed by titles/scope and nearest actual English scope. Existing other-constructions-for-manufacturing is a new specialized physical capital asset with cold-testing gate, explicitly excludes manufactured goods/operational emissions/upstream feedstocks and lacks retained reconstruction material/old-resource accounting plus actual thermal/hot-trial charge-output attribution. It cannot silently cover this service with required first-lining/hot-heat acceptance. Existing industrial-buildings expressly excludes foundries/production plant and later repair. Single-trade concrete/steel/electrical/pipe/firebrick installation and building-connection retrofit supply upstream services, not integrated foundry reconstruction acceptance. New semantic record is justified by retained-state and hot-trial methodology, not CPC leaf or merely asset/service wording.
limitations: No universal two-furnace/5ton/IGBT/coolant recipe, heat duration, acceptance values, emission factor, yield or lifetime from source cases.

Initial lining/dryout/sintering and hot trials are actual project construction/commissioning activities, record all their actual energy/charges/resources including failed attempts, but no routine post-handover production.

Actual hot-trial ferrous charge, sampled/tapped/retained/recharged metal, slag/dross, refractory/filters and actual substances require compatible measured stock/fate ledgers. Internal returned melt/heel/sprues are stocks/transfers not new external purchases. No residual estimate of burn or air release from input mass.

Actual useful historical equipment and actual accepted test-metal exports are separate Product outputs with native qty/state/receiver/transfer; current unused supply return is separate. Do not force all to Waste or award automatic credits. All necessary noncommercial commissioning burdens remain on service with transparent physical outlets; if a trial is deliberately commercial co-production, separate the production boundary and require explicit justified attribution before final dataset, do not silently assume zero or treat commercial metal as free.

Prefer the fewest independently meaningful cards/nodes, with conditional actual SKU/native-unit expansion; no imposed numeric card cap and no boilerplate phase-by-phase duplication. Separate real process nodes only for independently evidenced responsibility/physical handoff.

Root separately verified Count property/group and native Mass/Volume/Length/Area/freight support, not concrete product-flow identity. Actual native Energy, Time, provider services and gases may require separate support; do not substitute NCV/GCV or currency/Count.
